questions.question:
Study the given chart carefully and answer the question accordingly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08dfa27643b7a9c850179bd66de4f5aa41a8e93b7992b8778c687b64f66be2c6.png] 

In which of the following years was the percentage increase in production from the previous year, the maximum among the given years?
questions.solution:
**Concept used :**

Percentage increment = (Final value - initial value)/(Initial value) × 100 

**Calculations :**

Production increment in 2011 = (800 - 500)/(500) × 100 = 60%

Production increment in 2012 = (1200 - 800)/(800) × 100 = 50%

Production increment in 2014 = (1300 - 900)/900) × 100 = 44.44% 

Production increment in 2016 = (1500 - 1000)/(1000) × 100 = 50% 

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
The bar graph shows the number of cars sold by a distributor in each month from January to June.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c85e60777a3c6573a58ab89f1fd181268be6f86e51fb575e21b952e743eab671.png] 

How many more cars did he sell in the second quarter as compared to the first?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Cars sold in first quarter = 100 + 85 + 60 = 245

Cars sold in second quarter = 95 + 110 + 70 = 275

Increased sale = 275 - 245 = 30

**∴ He sell 30 more cars in the second quarter as compared to the first quarter.**

In which of the following weight groups is the number of teachers the maximum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 40 - 45 = 3

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 45 - 50 = 5

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 50 - 55 = 4

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 55 - 60 = 7

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 60 - 65 = 9

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 65 - 70 = 5

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 70 - 75 = 6

**Calculation:**

We clearly see that, 

Numbers of teachers in the age group of 60 - 65 = 9

Which is maximum teachers in this group.

**∴ The numbers of teachers in the age group of 60 -65 is 9 which is maximum.**

questions.question:
The given data shows the number of mobiles (in thousands) manufactured by companies C - 1, C - 2 C - 3 and C - 4 in 2017, 2018 and 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1038c5813be6f39e77ff924bb49ae95792e24c7450a5f47652bd5dee80699b3b.png] 

Which company witnessed the highest increase in manufacturing from 2017 to 2018?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Increase in numbers of manufactured mobiles for Company C1 from 2017 to 2018 = 65000 - 59000 = 6000

Increase in numbers of manufactured mobiles for Company C2 from 2017 to 2018 = 67000 - 62000 = 5000

Increase in numbers of manufactured mobiles for Company C3 from 2017 to 2018 = 71000 - 68000 = 3000

Increase in numbers of manufactured mobiles for Company C4 from 2017 to 2018 = 62000 - 59000 = 3000

**∴ The highest increase in manufacturing from 2017 to 2018 is in company C1 which is 6000 mobiles.**
